DECISION: reach-target-tests-successor-decision-20261024
Author: the overseer, acting under the operator's October13 delegation.

Approve ONE corrective successor of optionA, subject to the budget below. No trainer ran; preserve the failed82test receipt, cancelled rows, original adoptions and first clock unchanged. Do not relabel this attempt PASS.

Fix: tests about the historical base must read an explicit pinned Git blob, verifying its expected c41d82f5... hash. Do not rely on a moving HEAD parent after subsequent commits. In addition, retain/add the narrow installed-state checks: current main admission code equals the reviewed applied artifact; the exact intended new routes admit only the authorized configurations; unrelated/wrong-command/used/cancelled routes remain refused; prior route behavior remains intact. Merely making all four tests read an old blob would fail to check what actually runs. Exercise this before/after distinction in the existing focused review, no broad suite.

Successor bookkeeping: new row IDs and attempt paths are allowed for this single corrective attempt. Final trainer a48cac796, fingerprints, start/end, scientific settings and shared physical comparison remain unchanged. Repin only necessary command output paths/hashes, row identities and owner path/hash in routes10/11 through reviewed normal permission handling. Preserve old written-unused adoptions as historical blocked records; use existing supported supersession/rebinding, never erase consumption/history or resurrect cancelled rows. OFF and ON retain distinct decision identities and one-use enforcement. Review the exact delta and re-seal. A platform refusal is not authority to switch tools or agents.

BUDGET: carry113.6seconds forward. The experiment has786.4seconds left, not a fresh900. This explicitly authorizes one corrective attempt despite the former no-retry condition; it does NOT reset its time. Retain original clock and link successor clock with113.6 opening expenditure. Count new execution checks/tests/registration/admission/loading/training/save/closure. Coding/review time is separately reported; do not hide a repeated executable acceptance run as coding to evade the cap.

Before launching OFF, produce a compact ledger from the measured first attempt: registration, guard, each admission call, tests, other checks; then estimate both branches and final closure using the existing measured trainer basis. Identify precisely why the owner says ON cannot fit. Do not start an expensive OFF-only half if the projected pair already fails. Use the existing ON rule with measured pending work and retain300seconds per trainer plus100seconds closure and the branch-close allowance. No invented faster timing, reduced save reserve or omitted safety checks. Reuse immutable passing evidence where the reviewed owner already supports it; no mandatory repeat of unchanged164/299suites. Check the actual updated remaining time again before ON.

If the pair fits after the narrow repair and all review/admission/resource conditions pass, execute the successor under this amendment without another signature request. If it cannot fit, STOP before OFF and send the concrete timing ledger and a smaller proposed comparison; do not start a new clock or another test series. Extra time beyond900seconds has NOT been authorized. No third attempt.

The installer cleanup grant is USED. No further removal or closing operator programs is authorized. Existing launch-capacity mechanism, runtime checks and all preservation/pairing conditions remain unchanged. r2 remains held. Update D1 with the integration-test mismatch and required installed-state coverage so this failure is not repeated on the next admission edit. Return one consolidated corrected package/launch receipt or exact budget blocker.
